## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what this change does.

## Verification

List exact checks and results. Identify anything not run and why.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused; no unrelated changes or new dependencies without review.
- [ ] Default behavior and original report evidence remain compatible, or changes are explained.
- [ ] No datasets, weights, private documents or credentials are included.
- [ ] Frozen scientific identities/evidence are preserved; no unapproved scoring or calibration.
- [ ] Documentation and limitations match actual behavior.
- [ ] AI assistance, if used, is disclosed without inventing independent verification.
